findings.evidence: Row 1: Full name field with id='name-input' name='full_name'. Row 12: Your name field with id='legalname-input' name='legal_name'. Both use autocomplete='name' and collect the same personal name data.
findings.fix: Remove the duplicate 'Your name' field, or if both are needed for different purposes (e.g., one for display, one for legal), clarify the distinction in the labels.
findings.violation: The form asks for 'Full name' (#name-input) at the start and then asks for 'Your name' (#legalname-input) again later, requesting the same information twice.

findings.evidence: Secondary button: style="padding:12px 20px;font-size:16px". Primary button: no styling declared.
findings.fix: Either remove the explicit styling from the 'View details' button or add more prominent styling to the 'Create account' button to ensure the primary action is visually most prominent.
findings.violation: The secondary 'View details' button is styled with explicit padding (12px 20px) and font-size (16px), while the primary 'Create account' submit button has no declared styling, making the secondary action as prominent or more prominent than the primary action.

findings.evidence: The field is marked required='' but serves to collect a preference that could be asked in a profile update or preferences screen after the account is created.
findings.fix: Either make this field optional or move it to a post-signup preferences screen so account creation is not blocked by this preference.
findings.violation: The 'Preferred contact time' field is required but does not appear necessary for initial account creation; it could be collected after account setup in a separate step.

findings.evidence: style="padding:12px 20px;font-size:16px" results in: top/bottom padding (24px) + text height at 16px with standard 1.2 line-height (~19px) = ~43px total.
findings.fix: Increase padding or font size on the button to ensure the target is at least 44 pixels in the shortest dimension, or increase line-height to increase text height.
findings.violation: The 'View details' button renders at approximately 43 pixels in height (12px padding top + 12px padding bottom + ~19px text at 16px font with default line-height), which is below the recommended 44-pixel minimum for a mobile fingertip target.
